title: Let an agent test your web app

scenes.title: Turn acceptance criteria into browser tests
scenes.caption: The agent writes tests. The worker reruns them and checks they fail when the app filter is deliberately broken.
scenes.label: BROWSER QA / CURRENT COMMANDS AND FILES CAPABILITIES

steps.title: A preview contract
steps.detail: An existing release board. Three rows, a working filter and a mobile layout to verify.

steps.title: Agent-written tests
steps.detail: OpenCode writes qa.mjs. Playwright drives real Chromium and produces screenshots.

steps.title: A regression gate
steps.detail: Rerun the suite. Break the filter deliberately and require the same tests to reject it.

scenes.title: The browser runs inside the sandbox
scenes.caption: Only synthetic app source is provided to the model. No production site, credentials or customer browser session is involved.
scenes.label: BROWSER QA / CURRENT COMMANDS AND FILES CAPABILITIES

steps.title: Your Node worker
steps.detail: Published SDK. Upload fixtures, track commands, compare bytes and download artifacts.

steps.title: One sandbox
steps.detail: OpenCode, Node and Chromium. Local-only HTTP app. No public browser or agent endpoint.

steps.title: External free model
steps.detail: Receives synthetic task context. No paid key or managed browser subscription.

scenes.title: Run the complete worker example
scenes.caption: The downloadable example supplies the fixture, complete prompt, worker, artifact checks and cleanup. No paid model fallback.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT
scenes.content:
npm install @h-sandbox/sdk@0.4.0
export OPENCODE_MODEL=opencode/mimo-v2.5-free
node browser-qa.mjs

scenes.title: Set the contract before the agent starts
scenes.caption: Expected results come from the caller. The agent receives an app and requirements, not a prewritten test suite.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT
scenes.content:
Initial rows     Portal / Search / Billing
Passed          Portal only
All             three rows restored
Desktop         1280 x 720
Mobile          390 x 844 / no horizontal overflow

scenes.title: Prepare Chromium in the remote workspace
scenes.caption: These commands run inside the sandbox, not on your worker. Do not assume stock OpenCode includes a browser.
scenes.label: REMOTE SETUP / 175s IN THIS RUN / WAITING EDITED
scenes.content:
npm install --save-exact playwright@1.60.0
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

scenes.title: Start a tracked server, then check readiness
scenes.caption: The local health check must succeed. Detached returns a job handle, not a ready application.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: The full prompt: browser interactions
scenes.caption: The agent must observe real rows, select Passed, restore All and capture the result in Chromium.
scenes.label: browser-prompt.txt / COMPLETE PROMPT / PART 1 OF 2
scenes.content:
Read browser-app.html and write qa.mjs using playwright and node:assert/strict.
The app is already running. Use process.env.BASE_URL as the target URL.
Launch headless Chromium; always close it in finally. Do not start a server.
At 1280x720, assert three visible release rows on load.
Select Passed in the Status dropdown and assert only Portal is visible using node:assert immediately after selectOption; do not wait for expected row counts.
Select All and assert the three rows return. Save desktop.png after restoring All.

scenes.title: The full prompt: artifacts and guardrails
scenes.caption: The prompt names every output and forbids fabricated results. The worker still independently checks acceptance.
scenes.label: browser-prompt.txt / COMPLETE PROMPT / PART 2 OF 2
scenes.content:
At 390x844, assert there is no horizontal page overflow and save mobile.png.
Write qa-report.json with exactly initialRows:3, passedNames:["Portal"], restoredRows:3, mobileOverflow:false, using observed browser values.
Do not modify browser-app.html, browser-server.mjs, package files or configuration.
Do not mock Playwright, fabricate results or catch assertion failures to exit successfully.
Use your tools to write and execute qa.mjs, then inspect the results.

scenes.title: Build and execute the agentCommand
scenes.caption: The four-minute agent command runs in /workspace. Raw reasoning stays private; only reviewed evidence is published.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Inspect the assertion OpenCode actually wrote
scenes.caption: The recorded assertion reads browser state. The later mutation check proves it rejects the extra visible rows.
scenes.label: qa.mjs / RECORDED AGENT-WRITTEN ASSERTION EXCERPT

scenes.title: Independently rerun the generated tests
scenes.caption: Fresh artifacts must be created. Existing output from the agent run cannot satisfy the independent rerun.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT
scenes.content:
rm -f qa-report.json desktop.png mobile.png
BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 node qa.mjs

scenes.title: Retrieve the real desktop screenshot
scenes.caption: A real 1280 x 720 Chromium screenshot, downloaded through the Harakiri SDK after the independent run.
scenes.label: desktop.png / ACTUAL CHROMIUM OUTPUT / DOWNLOADED THROUGH SDK

scenes.title: Check the mobile viewport too
scenes.caption: Real 390 x 844 screenshot. The generated test reports no horizontal overflow for this fixture.
scenes.label: mobile.png / ACTUAL CHROMIUM OUTPUT / DOWNLOADED THROUGH SDK

scenes.title: Break the filter and require a failing test
scenes.caption: A browser startup error is not accepted as regression detection. The broken filter must trigger an assertion failure.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Accept evidence, not a green agent message
scenes.caption: Original app passes. Broken filter fails. Screenshots downloaded. Model steps reported zero cost in this run.
scenes.label: RECORDED RUN / INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
scenes.content:
Original app      passed
Broken filter     assertion failed (exit 1)
Source and tests  unchanged
Artifacts         desktop.png / mobile.png
Model steps       zero reported cost

scenes.title: Terminate both servers with the sandbox
scenes.caption: The capture independently confirms termination. Setup failures, unavailable models and failed assertions also require cleanup.
scenes.label: browser-qa.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT
